novelty.justification: The claim proposes a new mechanistic explanation—“factual associations are written into the residual stream at the subject token,” creating a “directional key-value binding from subject to object”—rather than a new behavioral setting, with directional decodability as its measurement. Searches using “reversal curse mechanistic explanation subject token,” “reversal curse causal tracing probing,” and “directional factual recall subject enrichment” identify Berglund et al. (2023) and Delving into the Reversal Curse (NeurIPS 2024) as the closest behavioral and recall-bias work, while Meng et al., Locating and Editing Factual Associations in GPT (NeurIPS 2022), already establishes subject-token factual enrichment; Tracing and Dissecting How LLMs Recall Factual Knowledge for Real World Questions (ACL 2025) likewise reports subject augmentation and object retrieval stages. Connecting those established subject-anchored recall results to reversal failure is a natural but non-trivial extension, with the specific absent-inverse-locus prediction and asymmetry index adding a useful operationalization, rather than a wholly new core interpretability paradigm.
